===== M1558 =====
Signature: com.google.javascript.jscomp.NameAnalyzer.createNameInformation(NodeTraversal,Node,Node)
Source: src/com/google/javascript/jscomp/NameAnalyzer.java
Original range: 1307-1407
Documentation:
/**
   * Creates name information for the current node during a traversal.
   *
   * @param t The node traversal
   * @param n The current node
   * @param parent The parent of n
   * @return The name information, or null if the name is irrelevant to this
   *     pass
   */
Method code:
1307 |   private NameInformation createNameInformation(NodeTraversal t, Node n,
1308 |       Node parent) {
1309 |     // Build the full name and find its root node by iterating down through all
1310 |     // GETPROP/GETELEM nodes.
1311 |     String name = "";
1312 |     Node rootNameNode = n;
1313 |     boolean bNameWasShortened = false;
1314 |     while (true) {
1315 |       if (NodeUtil.isGet(rootNameNode)) {
1316 |         Node prop = rootNameNode.getLastChild();
1317 |         if (rootNameNode.getType() == Token.GETPROP) {
1318 |           name = "." + prop.getString() + name;
1319 |         } else {
1320 |           // We consider the name to be "a.b" in a.b['c'] or a.b[x].d.
1321 |           bNameWasShortened = true;
1322 |           name = "";
1323 |         }
1324 |         rootNameNode = rootNameNode.getFirstChild();
1325 |       } else if (NodeUtil.isObjectLitKey(
1326 |           rootNameNode, rootNameNode.getParent())) {
1327 |         name = "." + rootNameNode.getString() + name;
1328 | 
1329 |         // Check if this is an object literal assigned to something.
1330 |         Node objLit = rootNameNode.getParent();
1331 |         Node objLitParent = objLit.getParent();
1332 |         if (objLitParent.getType() == Token.ASSIGN) {
1333 |           // This must be the right side of the assign.
1334 |           rootNameNode = objLitParent.getFirstChild();
1335 |         } else if (objLitParent.getType() == Token.NAME) {
1336 |           // This must be a VAR initialization.
1337 |           rootNameNode = objLitParent;
1338 |         } else if (objLitParent.getType() == Token.STRING) {
1339 |           // This must be a object literal key initialization.
1340 |           rootNameNode = objLitParent;
1341 |         } else {
1342 |           return null;
1343 |         }
1344 |       } else {
1345 |         break;
1346 |       }
1347 |     }
1348 | 
1349 |     // Check whether this is a class-defining call. Classes may only be defined
1350 |     // in the global scope.
1351 |     if (NodeUtil.isCall(parent) && t.inGlobalScope()) {
1352 |       CodingConvention convention = compiler.getCodingConvention();
1353 |       SubclassRelationship classes = convention.getClassesDefinedByCall(parent);
1354 |       if (classes != null) {
1355 |         NameInformation nameInfo = new NameInformation();
1356 |         nameInfo.name = classes.subclassName;
1357 |         nameInfo.onlyAffectsClassDef = true;
1358 |         nameInfo.superclass = classes.superclassName;
1359 |         return nameInfo;
1360 |       }
1361 | 
1362 |       String singletonGetterClass =
1363 |           convention.getSingletonGetterClassName(parent);
1364 |       if (singletonGetterClass != null) {
1365 |         NameInformation nameInfo = new NameInformation();
1366 |         nameInfo.name = singletonGetterClass;
1367 |         nameInfo.onlyAffectsClassDef = true;
1368 |         return nameInfo;
1369 |       }
1370 |     }
1371 | 
1372 |     switch (rootNameNode.getType()) {
1373 |       case Token.NAME:
1374 |         // Check whether this is an assignment to a prototype property
1375 |         // of an object defined in the global scope.
1376 |         if (!bNameWasShortened &&
1377 |             n.getType() == Token.GETPROP &&
1378 |             parent.getType() == Token.ASSIGN &&
1379 |             "prototype".equals(n.getLastChild().getString())) {
1380 |           if (createNameInformation(t, n.getFirstChild(), n) != null) {
1381 |             name = rootNameNode.getString() + name;
1382 |             name = name.substring(0, name.length() - PROTOTYPE_SUFFIX_LEN);
1383 |             NameInformation nameInfo = new NameInformation();
1384 |             nameInfo.name = name;
1385 |             return nameInfo;
1386 |           } else {
1387 |             return null;
1388 |           }
1389 |         }
1390 |         return createNameInformation(
1391 |             rootNameNode.getString() + name, t.getScope(), rootNameNode);
1392 |       case Token.THIS:
1393 |         if (t.inGlobalScope()) {
1394 |           NameInformation nameInfo = new NameInformation();
1395 |           if (name.indexOf('.') == 0) {
1396 |             nameInfo.name = name.substring(1);  // strip leading "."
1397 |           } else {
1398 |             nameInfo.name = name;
1399 |           }
1400 |           nameInfo.isExternallyReferenceable = true;
1401 |           return nameInfo;
1402 |         }
1403 |         return null;
1404 |       default:
1405 |         return null;
1406 |     }
1407 |   }

489 |     // expects.

503 |         } else {

505 |         }
506 |       } else {

Signature: com.google.javascript.jscomp.CheckGlobalThis.shouldTraverse(NodeTraversal,Node,Node)
Source: src/com/google/javascript/jscomp/CheckGlobalThis.java
Original range: 79-151
Documentation:
/**
   * Since this pass reports errors only when a global {@code this} keyword
   * is encountered, there is no reason to traverse non global contexts.
   */
Method code:
79 |   public boolean shouldTraverse(NodeTraversal t, Node n, Node parent) {
80 | 
81 |     if (n.getType() == Token.FUNCTION) {
82 |       // Don't traverse functions that are constructors or have the @this
83 |       // or @override annotation.
84 |       JSDocInfo jsDoc = getFunctionJsDocInfo(n);
85 |       if (jsDoc != null &&
86 |           (jsDoc.isConstructor() ||
87 |            jsDoc.isInterface() ||
88 |            jsDoc.hasThisType() ||
89 |            jsDoc.isOverride())) {
90 |         return false;
91 |       }
92 | 
93 |       // Don't traverse functions unless they would normally
94 |       // be able to have a @this annotation associated with them. e.g.,
95 |       // var a = function() { }; // or
96 |       // function a() {} // or
97 |       // a.x = function() {}; // or
98 |       // var a = {x: function() {}};
99 |       int pType = parent.getType();
100 |       if (!(pType == Token.BLOCK ||
101 |             pType == Token.SCRIPT ||
102 |             pType == Token.NAME ||
103 |             pType == Token.ASSIGN ||
104 | 
105 |             // object literal keys
106 |             pType == Token.STRING)) {
107 |         return false;
108 |       }
109 | 
110 |       // Don't traverse functions that are getting lent to a prototype.
111 |       Node gramps = parent.getParent();
112 |       if (NodeUtil.isObjectLitKey(parent, gramps)) {
113 |         JSDocInfo maybeLends = gramps.getJSDocInfo();
114 |         if (maybeLends != null &&
115 |             maybeLends.getLendsName() != null &&
116 |             maybeLends.getLendsName().endsWith(".prototype")) {
117 |           return false;
118 |         }
119 |       }
120 |     }
121 | 
122 |     if (parent != null && parent.getType() == Token.ASSIGN) {
123 |       Node lhs = parent.getFirstChild();
124 |       Node rhs = lhs.getNext();
125 | 
126 |       if (n == lhs) {
127 |         // Always traverse the left side of the assignment. To handle
128 |         // nested assignments properly (e.g., (a = this).property = c;),
129 |         // assignLhsChild should not be overridden.
130 |         if (assignLhsChild == null) {
131 |           assignLhsChild = lhs;
132 |         }
133 |       } else {
134 |         // Only traverse the right side if it's not an assignment to a prototype
135 |         // property or subproperty.
136 |         if (NodeUtil.isGet(lhs)) {
137 |           if (lhs.getType() == Token.GETPROP &&
138 |               lhs.getLastChild().getString().equals("prototype")) {
139 |             return false;
140 |           }
141 |           Node llhs = lhs.getFirstChild();
142 |           if (llhs.getType() == Token.GETPROP &&
143 |               llhs.getLastChild().getString().equals("prototype")) {
144 |             return false;
145 |           }
146 |         }
147 |       }
148 |     }
149 | 
150 |     return true;
151 |   }
